description: Get a link to subscribe to Hostlo Pro, or, for an account that already pays, to the billing page where the card, the invoices and cancelling live. Give the link to the person; nothing is charged until they finish on Stripe. Pro costs $7 a month or $70 a year (a founding price of $50 a year applies while the first 100 places last) and adds custom domains, 5 sites, 1 GB per site, 90 days of visitor statistics and no badge. The first 14 days are refundable in full.

billed.description:
How the Pro plan should be billed: "monthly" ($7) or "yearly" ($70, or $50 while founding places last). Ignored for an
account that already subscribes, which gets its billing page instead.
